stem: Which sentence from the story best shows that Brody realizes that he has been an irresponsible team leader?

options.label: A
options.text: "Um, let’s just go up the way we came down."

options.label: B
options.text: He deserved every bit of the anger he sensed from them.

options.label: C
options.text: "Early tomorrow morning, we’ll beat all the other teams’ times."

options.label: D
options.text: The team traced the route to Area 1 on paper and then practiced it at least 10 times.
